About SlideIQ

Move tiles through an empty space to bring a scrambled puzzle back into order. SlideIQ turns a simple movement rule into a planning challenge. Sometimes you need to move a tile away from its destination to create room for the next move.

How to play

  1. Inspect the scrambled tiles and the empty space.
  2. Slide a neighboring tile into the gap.
  3. Plan a sequence of moves that puts the puzzle back in order.
